packs.title: Rivers, Hills & Makers
packs.promise: Explore Pittsburgh through market streets, art rooms, gardens and hilltop river views.

q.s: Compare a market frontage with an older warehouse detail
st: Walk an open public sidewalk on the Strip's Penn Avenue market blocks.
Find one visible retail display and one older building material without entering or photographing a person.
Describe how the two details show different uses of the street.

q.s: Find a change in leaf, light or air
st: In two open conservatory rooms, notice a change in light, moisture or plant form.
Write one visible clue from each space.
Pause to ask what each plant might need from its setting.

q.s: Compare a slope route with the river below
st: From the public upper-station area or observation viewpoint, trace the incline track down the hill with your eye.
Name one river or bridge visible beyond it.
Draw two lines to show the steep route and flatter river route.

packs.title: Golden Triangle to North Shore
packs.promise: Walk Pittsburgh's compact Downtown core, the Point and the North Shore across two connected afternoons.

q.s: Find a repeated roof or tower point
st: Walk the public exterior of PPG Place without entering a building.
Find three repeated pointed or reflective forms in the glass complex.
Describe how one form changes when you move across the plaza.

q.s: Follow two rivers toward the Point
st: Follow an open Point State Park promenade to a safe confluence viewpoint.
Identify the Allegheny and Monongahela joining to form the Ohio River.
Draw the meeting as three labeled directional lines; do not approach the water edge.

q.s: Notice how the bridge changes the river view
st: Cross on the marked pedestrian sidewalk if it is open, never in a vehicle lane.
From two safe points, compare the yellow structure against the river and Downtown skyline.
Record one change in what the bridge frames.
